@@ First Aid
@stat: Em
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for applications of emergency or treatment
  (limited to type of creature), such as attempts or slow bleeding or
  damaging deterioration. It is suggested provided with the proper tools or
  bandages, a character using aid could stop up to 5 hits/rnd of damage
  without resorting tourniquet. Used normally in the field without the
  benefits proper medical facility or elaborate equipment. See Section for
  more details.

@@ Gambling
@stat: Pr
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus when playing any game significant element of
  luck. Also includes cheating as a form improving one’s luck at any game.

@@ Mapping
@stat: SD
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus to making, recognizing and simple maps. This
  skill is not capable of producing fully detailed maps like those of a
  cartographer, but it is sufficient to the marking out one’s journey well
  enough to find one’s way  Rolemaster Standard Rules 202

@@ Orienteering
@stat: In
@description:
  aid to halt This skill provides a bonus for using landmarks, the sun, stars
  that, and other simple navigational tricks in order to arrive at a desired
  first location. Note that Orienteering provides only a general sense to a
  the proper direction towards a location; hazards, obstacles, of a distances
  are not learned. It is not capable of the sort of precise 32.2 results that
  Navigation will provide, but it is sufficient to make one's way across the
  countryside.

@@ Sailing

@@ Tactical Games
